blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has arrested over 120 Chinese nationals in a call-center-type commercial building along Ayala Avenue in Makati City for allegedly operating a “lust scam” targeting their same nationality as well as Filipinos.
